canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.data_origin: SSA Benefit Types directory and Retirement benefits page; high-level eligibility text only.
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.title: Social Security Retirement benefits
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.description: SSA states that monthly Retirement benefits are typically available starting at age 62 for people who worked and paid Social Security taxes for 10 years or more. Other factors and exceptions are not captured here.

eligibility.program.published_requiremen.statement: Have worked and paid Social Security taxes for 10 years or more.

canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.data_origin: SSA Disability page; high-level eligibility text only.
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.title: Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI)
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.description: SSA describes Disability as monthly payments for people with a disability that stops or limits their ability to work. The page lists disability or blindness and enough work history as high-level conditions; detailed rules are not captured here.

source_metadata.source_version: Official SSA Benefit Types directory and linked benefit pages reviewed 2026-10-28; publisher revision dates were not displayed.

canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.data_origin: SSA Survivor benefits page; high-level eligibility text only.
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.title: Social Security Survivor benefits
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.description: SSA describes monthly benefits for certain eligible family members of a deceased person who worked and paid Social Security taxes. Relationship and work-history details require further review.

eligibility.program.published_requiremen.statement: You may qualify if you’re the spouse, divorced spouse, child, or dependent parent of someone who worked and paid Social Security taxes before they died.

canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.data_origin: SSA Family benefits page; high-level eligibility text only.
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.title: Social Security Family benefits
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.description: SSA states that Family benefits may be available to certain family members of people eligible for Retirement or Disability. It lists broad relationship categories but says age, marital status, and other factors also matter.

eligibility.program.published_requiremen.statement: Family benefits provide monthly payments to certain family members of people who are eligible for Retirement or Disability.
Spouses, ex-spouses, children, and some grandchildren may be eligible for Family benefits. We consider age, marital status, and other factors when we determine eligibility.

source_metadata.source_version: Official SSA Benefit Types directory and linked benefit pages reviewed 2026-10-28; publisher revision dates were not displayed.

canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.data_origin: SSA Supplemental Security Income page; high-level eligibility text only.
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.title: Supplemental Security Income (SSI)
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.description: SSA states that adults and children might be eligible with little or no income and resources plus disability, blindness, or age 65 or older. The payment amount depends on income, living situation, resources, and other factors; the full rules are not captured here.

eligibility.program.published_requiremen.statement: A disability, blindness, or are age 65 or older.

source_metadata.source_version: Official SSA Benefit Types directory and linked benefit pages reviewed 2026-10-28; publisher revision dates were not displayed.

canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.data_origin: SSA Plan for Medicare page; high-level access conditions only.
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.title: Medicare
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.description: SSA identifies Medicare as health insurance for people age 65 or older and says a person may also qualify with permanent kidney failure or by receiving Disability benefits. Enrollment timing and coverage rules are not captured here.

eligibility.program.published_requiremen.statement: You may also qualify if you have permanent kidney failure or receive Disability benefits.
Medicare is our country's health insurance program for people age 65 or older.
